assumptions: The observed failure is caused by run_ingestion lacking a repo_root parameter.
Incoming bundles may be ZIP files or directories.
done_means: ingest_incoming no longer raises unexpected keyword argument repo_root.
Incoming ZIP bundles can be evaluated in sandbox.
Reports and receipts write under the repository root.
purpose: Fix Core-Lite Intake by making run_ingestion accept repo_root and allowing incoming ZIP or directory bundles to be sandbox evaluated without installation.
